summary: The customer called expressing frustration over unexpected monthly charges and slow internet speeds. The agent apologized, understood the customer's issue, and offered an upgrade to the new fiber-optic package with a limited-time promotional price. The customer agreed, the agent successfully processed the upgrade, and the customer ended the call satisfied.
